record.one_liner: Harvest is a cloud time-tracking, expense, invoicing and project-budget tool for teams and agencies, with a companion Forecast scheduling product.
record.auth_notes: Personal access token created in Harvest ID Developers (default 'all' scope), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer' plus a 'Harvest-Account-Id' header, or as access_token and account_id query params. OAuth2 for third-party integrations: Authorization Code flow with refresh tokens, and Implicit flow. Scopes are harvest:{id}, forecast:{id}, harvest:all, forecast:all, all. Every request needs a User-Agent with an app name and a link or email, or it returns 400.
record.access_notes: The pricing page lists a $0 Free plan (1 seat, 2 projects) and a 30-day trial of paid plans. Tokens and OAuth apps are created in Harvest ID Developers. I did not find any vendor page stating API access by plan, so whether the Free plan includes API access is inferred, not verified. OAuth apps are created without a documented review step.
record.blocker: Rate limits: 100 requests per 15 seconds for general calls, 100 per 15 minutes for Reports. Free-plan API entitlement is unconfirmed. A User-Agent header and an account ID are required on every request.
